title: Client-token derivation: known customerId -> exact 32-hex token
description: The X-NameQuick-Client-Token is lowercase_hex(SHA256("namequick-proxy-client:" + customerId)) truncated to the first 32 hex characters. This vector pins the exact output for a fake customer id. Verified offline: printf '%s' "namequick-proxy-client:cus_test_0000000000" | shasum -a 256.
